items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Billy Gladstone, Max Manne, Carl Glassman, and Murray Spivack.

ctx.x: Billy Gladstone, Max Manne, Carl Glassman, and Murray Spivack. Whenever it came time for something to come up to do special, they called one of those guys. They were all excellent, what they did.
